eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Gestational age 11-14 weeks
* High risk of preeclampsia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active gastritis
* Abnormal coagulation profile (INR \> 1.5)
* Renal disease
* Platelet count \< 150,000/mm\^3
* Fetal malformations
* Vaginal bleeding

identificationModule.briefTitle: Comparison of High- Versus Low-Dose Aspirin for Pregnancy Outcomes in Women at High Risk of Preeclampsia
